Niven T. Achenjang

Welcome!

I am a BP and NSF postdoctoral fellow at Harvard, mentored by Melanie Matchett Wood. In 2027 (from Jan – Dec), I am on-leave from Harvard, and am instead an FSMP postdoc hosted by Olivier Wittenberg at LAGA at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord. I completed my PhD at MIT, advised by Bjorn Poonen.

I am broadly interested in arithmetic geometry, arithmetic statistics, and especially in points on varieties. I generally like applying algebro-geometric arguments and cohomology computations in the service of proving finiteness results. See the research tab for more on my work.

You can find more information about me and my work in my cv or under the “news” header below.

Fun fact: if you press the moon/sun in the top right, you can switch between light/dark themes for this site.

news

Nov 13, 2026 Katy Woo and I just posted an exciting new paper. The paper proves a generalization of Green-Sawhney’s \(p^2+nq^2\) result, and then uses to construct rank 2 elliptic curves in quadratic twist families and to deduce new successful instances of the fibration method for studying the Brauer-Manin obstruction on varieties fibered over \(\P^1\) (e.g. on conic bundles).
Nov 2026 I have not seriously touched this site in quite a while, so here are a few updates that have happened in the mean time:
  • My paper “The Brauer Group of \(\mathscr Y_0(2)\)”, with Deewang, Aash, Caleb, and Rose, has been published in Épijournal de Géométrie Algébrique.
  • My paper “The Average Size of 2-Selmer Groups of Elliptic Curves in Characteristic 2” has been accepted to MRL.
  • Starting Janurary 2027, I will be on-leave from Harvard (returning Jan 2028) and will instead be based in Paris, as an FSMP postdoc working with Olivier Wittenberg.
May 4, 2026 I am substituting for Ashvin’s mini-course in the CRM’s Universal Statistics in Number Theory summer school. Find the problem sheet for the first lecture here.
Jan 2026 This site is now hosted by Harvard instead of MIT. For the time being, any link to my former MIT site will automatically redirect here, but I think this will stop working at the end of the month (end of January 2026).
Aug 2025 I wrote (with the help of some friends) a postdoc application advice page.
Apr 2025 I am giving my thesis defense on April 15th. If I know you personally but forgot to mention this to you, you’re interested in attending, and you’re looking at my website for some reason, send me message and I’ll send you the room number and/or zoom link.
